name: RFC 4180
claims: CSV uses quoted fields, doubled quotes, and records separated by line breaks; fields containing delimiter, quotes, or line breaks require quoting.
limitations: CSV implementations vary; RFC 4180 is informational rather than a universal mandatory standard.

name: OWASP CSV Injection
claims: Spreadsheet applications may interpret cells beginning with formula-triggering prefixes as formulas.
limitations: No universal escaping scheme is safe for every spreadsheet workflow; exact preservation and mitigation can conflict.

name: WAI-ARIA APG Sortable Table Example
claims: Sortable native HTML tables can expose sort state with aria-sort on the active header and use real buttons in sortable headers.
limitations: W3C notes APG examples require browser/assistive-technology testing before production use.
